text: Very sorry to bother you at this hour. I am minding my grandaughter, she is 8. Her temprature is 37.9. She has a few insect bites on her ankles that are itchy, those I'm not worried about. But I noticed some little dark purpley red dots on her chest and tummy, tiny like pin pricks, and a couple of bigger patches like bruises on her legs that I can't explain. I did the glass test like on the telly and they don't go away when I press, you can still see them clear through the glass. I may be making a fuss over nothing and I apologise, but I thought I'd better ask someone.
